rules: Place exactly one queen in every row.
Place exactly one queen in every column.
Place exactly one queen in every lettered region.
Two queens must not touch, including diagonally adjacent cells.
Long diagonals are allowed: this is regional Queens, not chess N-Queens.
There is exactly one complete solution. Rows and columns are numbered from 1.
state.candidate_guarantees: Every candidate already has exactly one queen per row and column and no touching queens. Exactly one candidate also has exactly one queen per region.

pick.instructions: Choose the candidate whose occupied region letters contain A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I exactly once each, in ANY order, with no repeated or missing letter. Every candidate already satisfies all other Queens rules. Region letters were looked up accurately by code; counts and validity labels have NOT been supplied.
